name: Nehushta
title: Jehoiachin's Queen Mother
summary: Nehushta was the daughter of Elnatan from Jerusalem and the mother of King Jehoiachin of Judah. She was taken into exile in Babylon along with her son when Nebuchadnezzar captured Jerusalem in 597 BC. She is one of the few royal women mentioned by name in connection with Judah's last kings.

keyEvents.title: Nehushta's Background
keyEvents.description: Nehushta is presented as the daughter of Elnatan from Jerusalem and the mother of King Jehoiachin. She is mentioned in connection with Jehoiachin's accession to the throne.

keyEvents.title: Jehoiachin's Short Reign
keyEvents.description: Jehoiachin, Nehushta's son, became king at the age of eighteen and reigned for only three months in Jerusalem before the Babylonian siege.

keyEvents.title: The Babylonian Siege of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon besieged Jerusalem, and King Jehoiachin surrendered to the Babylonians along with his mother Nehushta.

keyEvents.title: The Exile to Babylon
keyEvents.description: Nehushta was taken into exile in Babylon together with her son Jehoiachin, the court officials, the nobles, and the craftsmen from Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Jeremiah's Prophecy about the Exile
keyEvents.description: The prophet Jeremiah prophesied that the king and the queen mother (Nehushta) would be cast out into a foreign land and never return.

keyEvents.title: Jeremiah's Lament over the King and the Queen Mother
keyEvents.description: Jeremiah urged the king and the queen mother to humble themselves, for their crown of glory would fall from their head.
